description: Returns the social accounts this aicut user has connected for publishing, with the id `prepare_post` takes, plus `connect_url`. WHEN: before any posting attempt, and whenever the user asks where they can post. Each entry carries its `platform` (tiktok, youtube or instagram) and `schedule_custody` (`aicut_scheduler`: a scheduled post waits in aicut; `platform`, i.e. YouTube: the video is uploaded at once as private and YouTube publishes it, so a scheduled YouTube post can only be changed in YouTube Studio). IF THE LIST IS EMPTY the user has connected nothing: connecting is a browser sign-in this API cannot do for them, so give them `connect_url` and stop (do not retry or offer to post anyway). THIS TOOL SUCCEEDING DOES NOT MEAN THE USER CAN POST: it needs read permission only, while `prepare_post` and `publish_post` need `social:publish`. A 403 from `prepare_post` right after this call returned an account is the missing publishing permission, not a contradiction and not a bad account id (see its REFUSALS). Read-only: posts nothing, spends nothing.
name: list_social_accounts
title: List connected social accounts
